1.note: Print reads like הזונות (ג and נ look alike in this type); read הזוגות, "the Pairs" (Zugot), which fits the context of Jehoshaphat's court.

3.note: Printed יוסף (Joseph); the Mishnah names him Yose ben Yoḥanan. Kept the sense; Hebrew kept as printed.

4.note: Name as printed (שלמינון); rendered as Shelamzion (Salome Alexandra).

5.note: Print reads like הסכה (ב and כ alike); read הסבה, "the reason".

6.note: First word unclear in the print (ובנוי / וכנוי); read as כנוי, "terms, names".

7.note: Print unclear (ובהו / וכחו); read וכחו, "its force".

8.note: Print reads like בונה התורה; read כונת התורה, "the intent of the Torah".

9.note: Print reads like גולות (ז and ו alike); read גזלות, "robbery".

10.note: Wording as printed; sense unclear. Rendered literally.

11.note: Print reads like דביר; read דבור (the Word, Logos), which fits "its concept" and "the Memra of the Targumim".

12.note: Print reads like הגשמה (ג and נ alike); read הנשמה, "the soul", after "the image of God".
